visual.description: Very dark olive-black that forms the dominant tone of the hero section background image.
Pure white background used for the main content sections between the hero and footer.
Vivid yellow used as the footer background, a strong brand accent surface.
Near-black used for large display headings and the site title logotype.
Very dark charcoal used for body copy, news headlines, and footer navigation links.
Dark grey used for secondary labels, dates, and meta text throughout the content area.
White used for the navigation links overlaid on the dark hero image.
Muted sage green used as the vertical side-rail strip flanking the main viewport.
Near-black used for the pill-shaped CTA button outlines and form input underlines.
Warm golden-brown used for the Michelin flower SVG icons in the header and footer.
Forest green used for the four-leaf clover Michelin icon in the header and footer.
Dark muted tone visible as the blurred overlay on the newsletter/landscape section background image.
